chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Ali ibn Atiyya, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) did not wear a ring except for a short while, until he left it.

key_terms.تَخَتَّمَ: To wear a ring (specifically on the finger)
key_terms.يَسِيراً: A short while / a little time

ai.seo_question: Why did the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) stop wearing his ring?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifies that the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) wore his ring for only a short duration before ceasing to do so, a practice often linked to the period before the prohibition of gold for men or specific legal rulings. This narration underscores the concept of *Naskh* (abrogation) in prophetic customs, illustrating how even established Sunnah practices could be temporarily adopted and later discontinued based on divine wisdom or changing circumstances.
